brief.objective: Produce the minimum safe implementation. Reuse existing code whenever possible.

instruction:
MISSION: BRIDGE_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTIC

OBJECTIVE:
Diagnose why Fleet requests remain in PENDING state.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Inspect the Fleet Bridge runtime.
- Determine whether the Bridge service is currently running.
- Determine whether it is running in watch mode or one-shot mode.
- Verify whether the Bridge is monitoring runtime/generated/fleet/requests/.
- Explain why recent requests remain in PENDING.
- Identify the exact blocking component if any.
- If the Bridge is stopped, explain how it should normally be started by the Runtime.
- Do not modify any file.
- Do not implement any change.
- Produce only a diagnostic report with the root cause and the recommended corrective action.
